item.title: 'From no bank account to same vendor accepting online payments': Macron praises India's AI shift as 'civilisational'
item.description: The French president pointed to India’s digital public infrastructure, a digital identity system covering 1.4 billion people, a payments network processing 20 billion transactions every month

item.title: Godfrey Phillips shares jump 31% in 3 days: What is driving rally in cigarette stock?
item.description: Godfrey Phillips delivered domestic cigarette sales volume growth of 25 per cent in the first nine months FY26 over the corresponding period of last year.

item.title: AI is nothing artificial, but it is intelligent, says Tata Group Chairman Chandrasekaran at the AI Summit
item.description: India AI Impact Summit 2026: AI will have a very profound impact in the same way other technological advancements, including the steam engine, electricity or internet, had, said Chandrasekaran.

item.title: TCS partners with OpenAI to build AI infrastructure; stock up 2%
item.description: In a filing exchanged on Thursday, TCS said it will work with the ChatGPT creator to co-develop industry-specific Agentic AI solutions.

item.title: This Jhunjhunwala stock falls 9%, hits 52-week low on NHAI action; check details
item.description: The infra stock crashed 9% to a 52-week low of Rs 136 today against the previous close of Rs 149.45. Market cap of the firm stood at Rs 9,285 crore.

item.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Google CEO Sundar Pichai says AI is the biggest 'platform shift of our lifetime', calls for collective action
item.description: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Sundar Pichai appealed to governments and tech companies for a collective frame, with trust as the "bedrock".

item.title: AI impact: FPIs sell Rs 10,956 crore worth of IT stocks in 15 days; holdings drop 16%
item.description: The recent selloff in several IT names dragged FPI's asset under custody (AUC) to Rs 4,48,938 crore as of February 15, down 15.92 per cent over Rs 5,33,953 crore as of January 31.

item.title: PM Modi presents MANAV Vision at the India AI Impact Summit 2026
item.description: India AI Impact Summit 2026: "AI is a transformative power. If directionless, it becomes a disruption; if the right direction is found, it becomes a solution," said PM Modi.
